(Sൾർඍංඈඇ 55) Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Wijayakoon Mudiyanselage Wijethunga Bandara who resides in the village of Ballapana Udabage, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Galigamuva, in the District of Kegalle. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Wijayakoon Mudiyanselage Wijethunga Bandara described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 28th March 2024 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, exparte action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 20th February, 2024.
